records.title: iFormer: Integrating ConvNet and Transformer for Mobile Application
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.15369. Primary abstract describes a mobile hybrid vision network evaluated on ImageNet, COCO, and ADE20k; it is not a language model.

records.title: Aristotle: Mastering Logical Reasoning with A Logic-Complete Decompose-Search-Resolve Framework
records.reason: The measured reduction is specific to structured logical reasoning and search steps; transfer to broader LLM inference cost is uncertain.

records.title: Distilled Decoding 1: One-step Sampling of Image Auto-regressive Models with Flow Matching
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.17153. Primary abstract concerns one-step sampling for image autoregressive generation and evaluates image-generation FID, not language-model inference.

records.title: ZipAR: Parallel Autoregressive Image Generation through Spatial Locality
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.04062. Primary abstract accelerates autoregressive visual/image generation using spatial locality; the target is image generation rather than LLM inference.
